feature: Evidence-based student development, prompt tags, tool activity and confidential-data signals

scope.competencies: 11 directions, dated evidence, original summaries and explicit learner/agent/together/unknown actors. Repeated independent demonstrations are mentor-reported evidence across distinct goals and project contexts, not a final grade.
scope.activity: 14/30/90 day windows; full-period aggregates with bounded recent evidence. Keyword tags describe prompt topics and intent, not proficiency.
scope.environment: Selected native application and current project only; bounded names and configuration presence, no configuration values or whole-machine inventory. Generic MCP and Claude Desktop snapshots are unavailable.
scope.tools: PostToolUse metadata where supported; mentor reports otherwise. Installed, used, configured and created are distinct observations. Tool arguments and results are never queued or uploaded.
scope.signals: Local detection emits category, severity and count. Claude Code hook contents and prompts can be checked; Codex tool hook contents are not supplied to the detector. A signal does not prove network transmission or a leak.
scope.notifications: In-dashboard open-alert counters and notifications, administrator review and false-positive decisions with audit. No external notification channel configured.
scope.privacy: Existing local anonymization and opt-out behavior retained. Outgoing school reporting is sanitized; native model chat is not intercepted and pattern detection is not exhaustive.
scope.legacy_data: Preserved. Older mentor reports may contribute conservative observations with unknown actor, never invented independence, tool events or retrospective secret alerts.
scope.activation: New metadata requires students to update their installed skill. Application trust and permission controls remain in force.
